entities.name: Zuzana Kocumová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zuzana Kocumová is a Czech cross-country skier who competed from 1996 to 2001. At the 1998 Winter Olympics in Nagano, she finished sixth in the 4 × 5 km relay, 35th in the 30 km event, 41st in the 5 km + 10 km combined pursuit and 59th in the 5 km event.
